name: Peconic Bay Vineyards
aliases: Peconic Bay Vineyards by Krissie Wines
description: A North Fork winery on Main Road with a tasting room, garden seating and an oyster bar. Its summer band series brings live music on Friday, Saturday and Sunday from late spring into the fall.

dancing.notes: Bands play outdoors while guests sit at garden tables and lounges, many booked ahead. A 2010 video shows a packed crowd dancing to a Latin band here, but that was under earlier owners. We found no recent reports either way, so ask before you plan to dance.

evidence.note: Winery home page lists live music every Friday, Saturday and Sunday and a May to October summer music series.
Reservation page says live music runs every Friday, Saturday and Sunday through November 1 and offers garden lounge tables.
2010 video of guests dancing to the Latin band Mambo Loco at the vineyard; the uploader says everyone was dancing by the third set.

reviewNotes: Added from the town-by-town source search (2026-10-05): a venue in local bands' gig lists.
